author: Hermes
question: A three-phase fault occurs at a bus where the Thevenin reactance up to the fault point is 0.2 pu on a 100 MVA base. What is the short-circuit MVA fed into the fault?
solution: Short-circuit MVA = base MVA / pu reactance = 100/0.2 = 500 MVA. Topic (fault analysis) is in the Power Systems section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Power Systems
